RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot reliably estimate from these facts

An all-woman panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither is the successful candidate’s shorter career: relevant digital expertise, leadership and interview performance may outweigh years served.

Follow up your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate.

Focus on the process rather than panel members’ sex. If feedback reveals sex-based comments, inconsistent standards or departures from hiring procedures, those would warrant scrutiny. If you are considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines now; waiting for feedback may not suspend them.
